testimonial.intro: Push Pull Legs with Mike already has several satisfied users.
testimonial.quote: Over the last few months, Mike has constantly talked my ear off about this app and forced me to go train with him. The app is okay. Because Mike spends a lot of time on dating platforms, you can swipe workouts, exercises and sets right and left. All in all, the app is pretty mid, but it doesn't cost anything either.
